channel.title: TotalMarket
channel.description: Indian markets, IPOs, tech and AI news, explained

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO opens Wednesday at ₹1,065–1,119 a share
item.description: A roughly ₹30,000 crore issue runs 21–23 October; Paras Healthcare also lists this week.

item.title: Sensex drops 876 points as Axis Bank and IT drag; markets shut today
item.description: Nifty ends at 22,888.95 after profit-taking snaps a two-day rally.

item.title: Nasdaq bounces 1.1% as tech recovers; Netflix, Tesla, Meta report this week
item.description: Amazon jumps nearly 5% as easing yields and oil help AI and chip stocks.

item.title: Oil stays above $100 as Houthi attacks hit Saudi targets
item.description: Brent near $108 keeps pressure on India's import bill and the rupee.

item.title: SEBI to make brokers show investor warnings in trading apps from 1 November
item.description: A new closing auction session for end-of-day prices is also being finalised.

item.title: Boldfit raises ₹400 crore as Indian startups pull in about $120M in a week
item.description: DailyObjects, Clueso and Mesa School of Business also closed rounds.

item.title: Zetwerk leads a ₹10,500 crore IPO week
item.description: Nine issues hit the market last week, from a ₹5,012 crore Zetwerk offer to small SME listings.

item.title: Anthropic sets aside 5% of its shares for a new Public Benefit Fund
item.description: The stake can grow as the company's valuation climbs, pending shareholder approval.

item.title: A hacker let AI agents loose on the web. They broke into 100+ sites for about $50 each
item.description: A low-cost autonomous campaign shows how cheap offensive hacking has become.

item.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian government systems
item.description: Washington tightens restrictions on the Chinese AI lab as it courts developers with cheap search.

item.title: Meta's AI shopping agent shared a seller's home address with a buyer
item.description: A privacy slip that shows the risk of handing agents personal data.

item.title: Microsoft walks away from a planned UK AI data center
item.description: Nscale says it will still build the Essex site without its anchor customer.

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is out, priced to undercut rivals
item.description: The new model is live for developers and in the Gemini app and Search.

item.title: Regulators close in on the big AI labs
item.description: The FTC, the EU and eight US states all opened new fronts in one week.

item.title: YouTube Music now labels AI-made songs
item.description: Tracks are tagged fully, partly or not AI-generated, and still earn money.

item.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion to take on Nvidia
item.description: The AI chipmaker's Series E values it at $6.2 billion.

item.title: Startup funding week: Ramp hits $60B, Modal raises $750M
item.description: 601 rounds and $31.9B raised in 30 days, with AI taking the biggest share.

item.title: Sensex jumps 1,500 points on strong IT earnings
item.description: TCS and HCLTech results lifted markets as crude eased and the rupee firmed.
